about: The class guides (Noah: a guide book for each class that tracks progression, given when the class is chosen). Each class's book is its own chapters, then a live 'Your Progress' page (drawn by the Codex from src/Classes.cpp ProgressNow), then the shared chapters. Paragraphs keep <b> and <i>. tools/gen_esp.py writes the books (BOOK guide_<class>) and src/Codex.h. (Noah: simple but accurate - each class: who you are, your altar, getting stronger, perks, trial and wonder; then three short shared pages.)

chapters.title: The Summoner
paras: A conjurer of the College of Winterhold. Your summons fight for you - every kill they make is yours: Cursed Essence, progress and trials.

You start with Conjure Wolf (left hand), Conjure Skeleton in your spellbook, the Riftblade (right hand) and the Arcane Conjurer Robes (your armour set: Tier I your summons take a fifth less, Tier II one more summon slot, Tier III your summons' kills heal you). Every Riftblade hit marks that enemy for your summons. Every 5th hit tears a rift and a Flame Atronach fights for you for 10 s - every 4th at Tier I (15 s), every 3rd at Tier II (a Flame, Frost or Storm Atronach, three at once); at Tier III the dead it kills rise as your thralls and every 10th hit a Dremora steps out.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Your kit - each item with its tier and the price of its next upgrade. Select one to upgrade it.
The Armory - more summon families open as you free cities: Daedra at 1, the Wild at 3, Dwemer at 5. You keep every family you buy.

Infuse - the altar's roll: a random Infusion on one of your items (left / right picks which). Blast Furnace, Dead Wire, Thunder Wall, Cryo-Lock, Turned or Soul Siphon. One per item; rolling again replaces it. 4,000 Cursed Essence, 2,000 more for each extra roll the same night.

Dragon Priest relics - every Dragon Priest you slay leaves a relic for your class. Take it at any Echo Altar: one of two. The Summoner's relics are the heroes and armies of old: Ysgramor, Gormlaith, Felldir, Hakon, Miraak, Karstaag, the Ebony Warrior, and four great armies.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: One curve for everything. Every item in your kit climbs Base, Tier I (1.5 times its damage), Tier II (3 times), Tier III - Legendary (5 times), then Ascends (+1.5 times each). Prices: Tier I 2,000, Tier II 5,000 (needs 2 freed cities), Tier III 12,000 (4 cities), Ascend 15,000 and 4,000 more each time (6 cities). Your class's armour set is in your kit too: it starts at 10 armour and every upgrade of the set adds 10, with a power of its own at each tier.

Summon slots - how many summons you can have out at the same time. You start with 2, and get one more for every 2 Echo Altars you free, up to 7 (8 with the Conjurer's Command Mead). When every slot is full, a new summon replaces your oldest one.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Bonebinder's Brew - your summons have 50% more health and deal 50% more damage.
Soul-Tether Wine - each time one of your summons kills an enemy, you heal 5% of your maximum health.
Conjurer's Command Mead - one more summon slot (up to 8).
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Pact of the Host (your city trial): let your summons make the kills - 20 on Novice up to 60 on Legendary.

Horn of the Spectral Wyrm (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. It calls a spectral dragon for a minute - until it falls once Alduin is slain.

chapters.title: The Battle-mage
paras: A battle-mage of the College of Winterhold: a different element in each hand, struck from afar - bolts, beams, storms and runes.

You start with Firebolt (right hand), Ice Spike (left hand), a Destruction tome and the Black Mage Robes - your armour set, its look growing at each tier (Mantled Robes, Plate, then the Black Archmage's ebony): Tier I spells cost 10% less, Tier II magicka comes back faster, Tier III spells cost a quarter less. Your magicka starts coming back 1 second after a cast.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Your kit - each element with its tier and the price of its next upgrade: each tier is the next spell of its ladder (Firebolt, Fireball, Incinerate, Immolate).
The Armory - more elements open as you free cities: Shock at 1, Sun at 3, Blood at 5, Runes at 7.

Infuse - the altar's roll: a random Infusion on one of your items (left / right picks which). Blast Furnace, Dead Wire, Thunder Wall, Cryo-Lock, Turned or Soul Siphon. One per item; rolling again replaces it. 4,000 Cursed Essence, 2,000 more for each extra roll the same night.

Dragon Priest relics - every Dragon Priest you slay leaves a relic for your class. Take it at any Echo Altar: one of two. Destruction's relics are the support spells: Ash Cloud, Cinder Storm, Charged Nova and Symmetry.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: One curve for everything. Every item in your kit climbs Base, Tier I (1.5 times its damage), Tier II (3 times), Tier III - Legendary (5 times), then Ascends (+1.5 times each). Prices: Tier I 2,000, Tier II 5,000 (needs 2 freed cities), Tier III 12,000 (4 cities), Ascend 15,000 and 4,000 more each time (6 cities). Your class's armour set is in your kit too: it starts at 10 armour and every upgrade of the set adds 10, with a power of its own at each tier.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Ember Heart Ale - Destruction kills burst and hurt the dead nearby.
Arcanist's Focus Tea - Destruction spells cost 25% less magicka.
Mana-Siphon Draught - each Destruction kill gives back 6% magicka.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of the Elements (your city trial): kill with two or more elements - 20 on Novice up to 60 on Legendary.

Tome of the Six Fires (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. One cast looses the top spell of all six elements around you.

chapters.title: The Ranger
paras: Sworn to the Dawnguard. Bows and crossbows - every arrow counts.

You start with the Ember Crossbow and its bolts, the Emberstring bow, and the Gondorian Ranger Armour (your armour set: Tier I you move 10% faster, Tier II your arrows and bolts come back faster, Tier III a kill from 30 m or more puts stamina back). You carry one crossbow and one bow; the rest wait in your class's chest - select one in your kit to take it up.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Your kit - each bow and crossbow with its tier and the price of its next upgrade.
The Armory - as you free cities: the Rime Crossbow at 1, Rimehorn at 2, the Storm Crossbow at 3, Stormreach at 4, Skyhowl at 6, Dawnspire at 8, Thirstbow at 9.

Infuse - the altar's roll: a random Infusion on one of your items (left / right picks which). Blast Furnace, Dead Wire, Thunder Wall, Cryo-Lock, Turned or Soul Siphon. One per item; rolling again replaces it. 4,000 Cursed Essence, 2,000 more for each extra roll the same night. (Cryo-Lock and Turned are the old special ammo.)

Dragon Priest relics - every Dragon Priest you slay leaves a relic for your class. Take it at any Echo Altar: one of two. The Ranger's relics are three quivers that make your bows' and crossbows' blasts reach wider.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: One curve for everything. Every item in your kit climbs Base, Tier I (1.5 times its damage), Tier II (3 times), Tier III - Legendary (5 times), then Ascends (+1.5 times each). Prices: Tier I 2,000, Tier II 5,000 (needs 2 freed cities), Tier III 12,000 (4 cities), Ascend 15,000 and 4,000 more each time (6 cities). Your class's armour set is in your kit too: it starts at 10 armour and every upgrade of the set adds 10, with a power of its own at each tier.
Each tier: more damage, a new attack and a bigger quiver - 60, 100, 150, 200 arrows. You never run dry: an empty quiver grows back one a second once you have stopped shooting for 5 seconds.
Crossbows: kills unlock elemental bolts - fire at 25, ice at 60, shock at 120.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Fletcher's Sap Draught - your arrows or bolts slowly grow back.
Eagle-Eye Draught - bows draw and crossbows reload 25% faster.
Dawnwatch Tonic - with a bow or crossbow out, the dead hurt you 25% less.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of the Long Shot (your city trial): bow or crossbow kills from 30 m or more - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

The Subsuming Vortex (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. Its arrows open black holes that drag the dead in, then burst - wider and stronger once Alduin is slain.

chapters.title: The Spellsword
paras: A Vigilant of Stendarr: steel in one hand, a touch spell in the other - fire, frost, shock, sun, blood or poison - that rides every blow of the blade.

You start with your sword (Odin's Wrath for a woman, the Madness Sword for a man), Burning Touch (left hand) and your armour set - the Valkyrie Armour for a woman, the DragonLord Armour for a man: Tier I you mend in a fight, Tier II your blade's hits put magicka back, Tier III Odin's Wrath awakens. No shields: your off hand is always a spell, and every blade hit casts it.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Your kit - the blade and each spell with its tier and the price of its next upgrade.
The Armory - one more spell for every city freed: Frost touch, Flame Breath, Shock touch, Frost Breath, Sun touch, Storm Breath, Blood touch, Poison touch, Blood Breath, Poison Breath.

Infuse - the altar's roll: a random Infusion on one of your items (left / right picks which). Blast Furnace, Dead Wire, Thunder Wall, Cryo-Lock, Turned or Soul Siphon. One per item; rolling again replaces it. 4,000 Cursed Essence, 2,000 more for each extra roll the same night.

Dragon Priest relics - every Dragon Priest you slay leaves a relic for your class. Take it at any Echo Altar: one of two. The Spellsword's relics are legendary two-handers: Trollsbane, the Rueful Axe, the Dawnguard Rune Hammer, Greatsword of the Righteous, Bloodskal, Volendrung, the Aetherial Great Spellsword and the Ebony Blade.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: One curve for everything. Every item in your kit climbs Base, Tier I (1.5 times its damage), Tier II (3 times), Tier III - Legendary (5 times), then Ascends (+1.5 times each). Prices: Tier I 2,000, Tier II 5,000 (needs 2 freed cities), Tier III 12,000 (4 cities), Ascend 15,000 and 4,000 more each time (6 cities). Your class's armour set is in your kit too: it starts at 10 armour and every upgrade of the set adds 10, with a power of its own at each tier.
Each reforge also raises your held spell-weapon a material and unlocks one of four Enchantment Powers (in your Powers).

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Bladesong Mead - each melee hit heals you 2%.
Spellbinder's Draught - melee kills give back 10% magicka.
Steel-Wind Ale - melee swings 20% faster.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of Steel (your city trial): melee kills with a spell in your other hand - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

Dragon Slayer (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. Every hit carries your off-hand spell; once Alduin is slain, power attacks send it down the line.

shared.title: How a Night Works
paras: Day (about 20 minutes): the dead sleep. Explore, rest and spend your Cursed Essence.

Night: the dead claw up out of the ground (on open ground, never in houses) in waves - fast runners, more and tougher each night, coming from every side. Elites and bosses step out of the Curse's portals. Dawn only comes when the last wave falls.

The night's dead are the curse's whole host, each under its own name: Mihail's zombies and the Thriceborn walk first with the Rag Draugr, rotten skeletons and plague wolves; then Bonemen, skeleton mages and the necromancers who serve the curse; then Hulking Draugr, Draugr Liches, Draman Brutes, Ash Spawn and werewolves; then the Daedra - Clannfear, Daedroth, Dremora - and at the last the Overlords, the Mythic Liches and the Skeleton Reaper Warlords. Casters keep back and raise more dead - kill them first.
Some nights the noise you make draws a hunter: a feral nightwalker, far faster than the rest, that comes through a portal and pounces.

Busy with a quest? Open the wait menu at night, once the countdown has ended, and choose Skip the Night. It passes the whole night to dawn and does not count: no night survived, and the next dusk brings the same night again.

Cursed Essence drops from every kill - spend it at the Echo Altars. Now and then a body drops a glowing token (1 kill in 50): walk into it before it blinks out (20 s). Nuke (the dead around you turn to ash), Double Essence (30 s), Refill Stats (ammo, health, magicka, stamina and your shout), Merchant's Blessing (the altars at half price, 45 s), Shadow of Nocturnal (the dead lose you, 15 s), Thu'um Unbound (no shout cooldown, 20 s) and Kynareth's Mercy (everyone healed, a fallen friend lifted). In a party, what one takes everyone gets. From dusk to dawn a lantern at your belt lights 20 metres round you. At dawn the dead leave their ash where they fell, and in a freed city its people leave an offering at their altar for you each day.
Your health, magicka and stamina sit on one plate at the bottom; its rim glows blue while your shout recovers.

shared.title: The Echo Altar
paras: Every city has one. Step onto it and activate it. Move with the D-pad or W/S, choose with A or Enter, leave with B.

From the top: your class (change it for Cursed Essence - each class keeps its own kit and progress), your kit (select an item to upgrade it), the Armory (new items, opened by freed cities), Infuse (the roll), a Dragon Priest's relic when one waits, perks, then the city's trials.

Freeing a city: finish four trials (three shared, one your class's), then slay its Dragon Priest, who rises at night. Its fall ends the night and leaves a relic. A freed city is a sanctuary, teaches you its Thu'um, and Whiterun gives you a dragon to ride.
Every 5th night a great boss walks with the dead - and its dawn leaves a power-up at your feet.

shared.title: Settings
paras: Difficulty is Skyrim's own (Settings, Gameplay). Novice is very easy, Apprentice easy, Adept normal, Expert hard, Master very hard and Legendary close to impossible. From Novice to Legendary the dead (and Skyrim's own foes against your altar gear) have 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.5x, 2.2x, 3.2x health, and the dead hit 0.4x, 0.65x, 1x, 1.4x, 1.9x, 2.6x as hard. Every Echo Altar freed makes them all 30% tougher (up to ten), to keep up with your upgraded gear. Until three altars are freed, on Adept or harder, no single hit takes more than 60% of a zombie's health.
Skyrim's own enemies get tougher with the difficulty and with every altar you free, so they keep up with you.
The Mod Configuration Menu page The Curse of Alduin has the rest: attack and draw speed, field of view, brightness, effects and controls.
